profileSummary.text: Fullstack Engineer with over one year of production experience since July 2025 on meeting-intelligence and IoT products. Builds APIs, web and mobile features, and reliable releases.

projects.narrative: Meeting assistant for searchable summaries and action items. Built resumable multipart uploads over 100 MB with server-backoff retries. Stack: React, NestJS, PostgreSQL, Redis, pgvector.
Smart-room controls and automation. Built commands, offline device-state feedback, and per-user permissions. Stack: Rust, Axum, PostgreSQL, MQTT, Zigbee2MQTT.
Markdown-driven portfolio with prerendered pages and AI job matching. Built hybrid retrieval over portfolio evidence. Stack: Svelte 5, TypeScript, Rust, PostgreSQL, pgvector.
Open-source AI workspace with server-run proof before acceptance. Built role orchestration, task tracking, and isolated execution. Stack: Go, Svelte, SQLite, MCP, Docker.
IoT operations platform for devices, automations, and telemetry. Built MQTT provisioning, control, OTA tracking, and observability. Stack: Nuxt, Hapi, PostgreSQL, MQTT, OpenTelemetry.

employmentBullets: Built resumable multipart uploads for 100 MB+ recordings, resuming parts with server-backoff retries.
